basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate exploring the world of car maintenance as a hobby. I live in a suburban area in the Midwest, and during the weekdays, I work as an entry-level IT technician. I enjoy learning new things, especially anything related to technology and DIY projects. I'm single and usually spend my evenings browsing Reddit, especially late at night when I have free time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, which I studied in college. My knowledge of car repair is mostly self-taught through online tutorials and forums. I'm still learning and often turn to Reddit and YouTube for guidance on car maintenance.
